stepTitle: A compound gear train is arranged from left to right. The leftmost driver gear (pink, $$14$$ teeth) meshes with the large gear of a central compound pair (blue, $$42$$ teeth). This blue gear is fixed to the same shaft as a smaller gear (yellow, $$14$$ teeth). The yellow gear meshes with the rightmost driven gear (orange, $$28$$ teeth). \n \n Consider the entire gear train described above. If the leftmost (pink) gear rotates at a rate of $$12$$ rotations per minute (RPM), calculate the rotation rate of the rightmost (orange) gear.
